questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question tests precise bit-level reasoning and avoids expensive operations in tight loops, useful in storage engines and query optimizers.

## Key Concepts

- Single-set-bit test: (n & (n-1)) == 0
- Even-index bit mask: 0x55555555
- Combining tests with boolean logic for a robust check

## Code Example

```javascript
function isSingleEvenBitSet(n) {
  return n !== 0 && (n & (n - 1)) === 0 && (n & 0x55555555) !== 0;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you generalize to check exactly k bits set?
- How would you adapt to 64-bit width and different bit-ordering considerations?

Why This Is Asked

- Exercises 128-bit lane manipulation and cross-lane masking
- Uses bitwise complements and masks across two 64-bit chunks

- Bitwise masking on 128-bit structures

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to extract tightly packed fields from a word using only bitwise ops, a common task in protocol parsing and low-level systems. Encourages precise masking and shift reasoning without branches.

## Key Concepts

- Bitwise shifts and masks
- Field extraction in packed integers
- unsigned arithmetic guarantees

uint32_t extractVersion(uint32_t header) {

}
